address: The Onyx Tower 2, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai
bio: There’s a buzzing atmosphere at this authentic izakaya, set in The Onyx Tower 2 in The Greens. Five ramen dishes underpin the menu, which also lists other Japanese classics including sushi, sashimi, robata and tempura. Ingredients are good quality, cooking is careful, prices are low and flavours, delicious. For a chance to watch the chefs preparing their signature dishes, be sure to book your seats on the counter in advance....
